verdict.rationale: Deepgram is API-first: its core product surfaces are documented as API endpoints with parameters, including transcription, streaming, voice agents, audio intelligence, diarization and callbacks. A published OpenAPI spec backs them, and the dg CLI and built-in MCP server also manage projects, API keys, team members and usage, so account administration is programmatic too. However, no source explicitly states that the API matches the console/UI feature for feature, and no hands-on report confirms it. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement or a documented management-API reference covering every console action (e.g. billing and settings), and independent corroboration of parity.
